pick.name: Ahrefs
pick.what: SEO suite: keyword volumes, backlinks, site audit, AI visibility
pick.why: Best keyword and competitor data once SEO is a channel.
pick.free_limits: Ahrefs Free for verified sites plus free tools; paid plans from Starter $29/mo, Lite $129, Standard $249 (page)

best_free.name: Google Trends
best_free.what: Relative search interest by region/time, related queries, rising topics
best_free.why: Free, no account, compares any countries or regions side by side; enough to judge direction of demand before you have a site.
best_free.free_limits: Free; shows relative 0-100 interest, not absolute volume

alts.name: Google Keyword Planner
alts.what: Google Ads keyword ideas and volume estimates
alts.why: Only free source of Google's own volume ranges; needs an Ads account with billing info.
alts.free_limits: Needs a Google Ads account with billing details; volumes are estimates/ranges

alts.name: Google Search Console
alts.what: Real queries and impressions for your own site

candidates.name: Google Trends
candidates.verdict: best_free: direction of demand, relative only

candidates.name: Google Keyword Planner
candidates.verdict: alt: volume ranges, needs Ads account

decision: Ahrefs gives the strongest keyword and competitor data; Semrush is the equal-tier alternative. Most founders need only Google Trends before launch and Search Console after, so pay only when SEO becomes a main acquisition channel.
details: Pick changed from Google Trends (now best_free) to a paid suite on capability.

verify.note: Starter $29/mo, Lite $129/mo and Ahrefs Free confirmed; Standard price not re-seen in this pass. Semrush is the equal alternative, as decision says.
